description: Verify that T1 = 0.5 × lease — RENEWING REQUEST emitted within T1 ± ParamToleranceTime of the last DHCPACK (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
T1 is when the client first tries to renew. RFC 2131 §4.4.5 sets it at half the lease — early enough to retry several times before T2. This case asserts the actual elapsed time between ACK and the renewing REQUEST is in [T1 - tol, T1 + tol].

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with lease = L.
2. Wait until t_ACK + 0.5 × L; DUT must emit renew DHCPREQUEST around this point.

[Pass condition]
(t_renewing - t_ACK) ∈ [0.5 L - tol, 0.5 L + tol].

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_t1_out_of_bounds — interval outside the tolerance window.

verdicts.Pass: RENEWING REQUEST at T1 ± tolerance — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_request_t1_out_of_bounds: DUT renewing REQUEST T1 interval out of bounds
